calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(closing_units) AS units
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-30' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category, s.store_id >= 900 AS non_store, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT cp.sku) AS skus, sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, min(fs.closing_units) AS min_units, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg, sum(CASE WHEN p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL AND p.delisted_on<=DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delisted_rows, sum(CASE WHEN s.close_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closedstore_rows, sum(CASE WHEN p.category<>cp.category THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cat_differs
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31' AS in_period, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonstore, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testcat, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
